proposal: sigma-specific Gaussian upper envelope over c in [0,1]
envelope_argument: C computes weight[z]=ceil(S*exp(-alpha_lo*d(z,[0,1])^2)) with outward MPFR rounding; therefore weight[z]/S is at least rho_sigma(z-c) for every c in [0,1).
note: The implementation encloses center, sigma, pi/sigma^2, square, exponential and scaled acceptance probability with directed rounding. A uniform value in the uncertainty band triggers a same-candidate precision doubling, so rounding cannot select a different branch. Production SampleLeft still additionally requires the perturbation sampler and its covariance proof.
